spans.s: जमन n. The same as जेमन.
जामदग्न्य m. A name of Paraśurāma.
जामातृ m. 1. A son-in-law, K.S.vii.55; 2. a lord, a master; 3. the sun-flower.
जामि f. 1. A sister; 2. a daughter; 3. a daughter-in-law; 4. a virtuous and respectable woman; 5. a near female relative, M.iii.57, 58.

जामित्र n. The seventh zodiacal sign from the natal one. In astrology, the sign is indicatory of the welfare, or otherwise of one’s wife; hence some derive the word from जाया, but it is found to be of Greek origin (Gr. diametron). See K.S.vii.1 and Mall. on it.
